scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web
scripts.check: bunx depcruise apps/api/src --config apps/api/.dependency-cruiser.js && bunx depcruise apps/web/src apps/web/tests --config apps/web/.dependency-cruiser.js && bunx depcruise packages/contracts/src --config packages/contracts/.dependency-cruiser.js
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test apps/api/tests && bun run test:project && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.budget: bun run build:web && bunx vitest run --root apps/web --config vitest.budget.config.ts
scripts.e2e: bunx playwright test && bun run e2e:clean
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check && bun run magic && bun run test && bun run budget
